card.name: Second digit of Bible chapter numbers
card.fires_on: The second digit of a two-digit chapter number in a Bible verse citation, such as the last 4 in Isaiah 44:6 or the 3 in Jeremiah 33:3. It fires mostly on repeated digits like 33, 44 and 54, right before the colon.

modes.label: Chapter digit in scripture citation
modes.description: A repeated or second digit of the chapter in a book-chapter:verse reference.

modes.label: Digit inside a DOI number
modes.description: A weaker case where a digit sits inside a DOI string.

card.plain: It marks the second digit of a chapter number in a Bible reference, just before the colon and verse.
